title: The Ethics of Pollution Pricing
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: We survey various ethical issues related to the use of pollution pricing. While pollution pricing, for example in the form of Pigouvian taxes or cap-and-trade systems, is widely used in environmental economics modeling, many moral and ethical assumptions lie behind those models, and many ethical objections to pollution pricing are disregarded. We hope this review will be helpful to environmental economists who are regularly engaged in the use of such models, and in economic reasoning more generally, but who are less familiar with their ethical underpinnings and possible implications.
abstract_zh: 本文综述了与使用污染定价相关的各类伦理问题。虽然以庇古税或总量控制与交易体系为形式的污染定价在环境经济学建模中被广泛使用，但这些模型背后隐含着诸多道德和伦理假设，而针对污染定价的许多伦理异议却被忽视了。我们希望这份综述能对经常使用此类模型的环境经济学家，以及更广泛地运用经济推理、但对其伦理基础及可能含义不太熟悉的研究者有所助益。

title: Fiscal Policy and Transition Risk
Air Pollution and Early Childhood Outcomes: Evidence from Georgia Childcare Providers
abstract: Many effects of pollution exposure on health and education outcomes of children have been identified, but little is known about education effects on preschool-aged children. We estimate the effect of particulate matter air pollution on preschool attendance using restricted administrative data from the state of Georgia. We use thermal inversions, weather phenomena that trap pollutants, as an instrumental variable for pollution. A one-unit increase in the county-week average ambient particulate pollution level decreases attendance by around 2 percentage points. Effects seem to be larger for racial minorities and for children with working parents. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 污染暴露对儿童健康和教育结果的诸多影响已得到识别，但对学龄前儿童的教育影响却知之甚少。我们利用佐治亚州受限使用的行政数据，估计了颗粒物空气污染对学前班出勤率的影响。我们以热逆温（即锁住污染物的天气现象）作为污染的工具变量。县–周平均环境颗粒物污染水平每增加一个单位，出勤率下降约2个百分点。对少数族裔儿童以及父母工作的儿童，影响似乎更大。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民可免费在www.nber.org下载本文。

title: An Ethical Pollution Tax
abstract: Through theory and numerical simulations, I explore how a pollution tax can be designed to accommodate ethical objections. I consider four types of objections that have been raised by ethicists – based on equity concerns, incommensurability, civic responsibility, and commodification. In each case, I theoretically derive a tax designed to respond to the objection, and quantitatively, using a general equilibrium model calibrated to the U.S. economy and carbon dioxide pollution, I show how these accommodations affect the magnitude of the tax and the resulting emissions level. Some accommodations likely have small effects on the carbon tax rate, while others can cause the tax rate to increase fivefold. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 本文通过理论推导和数值模拟，探讨如何设计污染税以回应伦理异议。我考虑了伦理学家提出的四类异议，分别基于公平关切、不可通约性、公民责任和商品化。针对每一类异议，我从理论上推导出一个旨在回应该异议的税率，并利用一个以美国经济和二氧化碳污染为校准对象的一般均衡模型进行定量分析，展示了这些调整如何影响税率水平及由此产生的排放水平。一些调整对碳税税率的影响可能较小，而另一些调整则可能使税率提高至五倍。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民可免费在www.nber.org下载本文。

title: Climate Change, Inequality, and Financial Frictions
Climate Policy Uncertainty and Inequality
Climate Policy, Job Reallocation, and Unemployment Fluctuations in a Multi-Sector Economy
Environmental Dynamic Stochastic General Equilibrium Models
The Credit Channel of Climate Policy Uncertainty
Theme Park Rides are Giffen Goods
Behavioral Economics and the Evidential Defense of Welfare Economics
Solar Geoengineering, Learning, and Experimentation
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Solar geoengineering (SGE) can combat climate change by directly reducing temperatures. Both SGE and the climate itself are surrounded by great uncertainties. Implementing SGE affects learning about these uncertainties. We model endogenous learning over two uncertainties: the sensitivity of temperatures to carbon concentrations (the climate sensitivity), and the effectiveness of SGE in lowering temperatures. We present both theoretical and simulation results from an integrated assessment model, focusing on the informational value of SGE experimentation. Surprisingly, under current calibrated conditions, SGE deployment slows learning, causing a less informed decision. For any reasonably sized experimental SGE deployment, the temperature change becomes closer to zero, and thus more obscured by noisy weather shocks. Still, some SGE use is optimal despite, not because of, its informational value. The optimal amount of SGE is very sensitive to beliefs about both uncertainties.
abstract_zh: 太阳地球工程（SGE）可以通过直接降低气温来应对气候变化。太阳地球工程本身以及气候系统都存在巨大的不确定性。实施太阳地球工程会影响人们对这些不确定性的学习。我们对两类不确定性进行了内生学习建模：气温对碳浓度的敏感性（气候敏感度），以及太阳地球工程降温的有效性。我们基于一个综合评估模型，给出了理论和模拟结果，并着重考察了太阳地球工程实验的信息价值。令人惊讶的是，在当前校准条件下，太阳地球工程的部署会减缓学习进程，导致决策所依据的信息更少。对于任何规模合理的实验性太阳地球工程部署，气温变化都将趋近于零，因而更容易被噪声较大的天气冲击所掩盖。尽管如此，某些程度的太阳地球工程使用仍是最优的，但这是尽管而非因为其信息价值。最优的太阳地球工程规模对这两类不确定性的信念都非常敏感。

title: Unemployment, Labor Mobility, and Climate Policy
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We develop a computable general equilibrium model of the US economy to study the unemployment effects of climate policy and the importance of cross-industry labor mobility. We consider two specifications of mobility costs: either perfect mobility with no moving costs, as is assumed in much previous work, or a model where workers face moving costs. The effect of a $45 per ton carbon tax on aggregate unemployment is small and similar across the two labor mobility assumptions (0.2 percentage points). The effect on unemployment in fossil fuel sectors is much larger under the immobility assumption—for example, a 13-percentage-point increase in the coal sector unemployment rate—suggesting that models omitting labor mobility frictions may greatly underpredict sectoral unemployment effects. Returning carbon tax revenue through labor tax cuts can dampen or even reverse negative impacts on unemployment, while command-and-control policies yield less efficient outcomes.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个美国经济的可计算一般均衡模型，以研究气候政策的失业效应，以及跨行业劳动力流动性的重要性。我们考虑了两种流动成本设定：一种是完全流动且无搬迁成本（如此前许多研究所假设），另一种是劳动者面临搬迁成本的模型。每吨45美元的碳税对总体失业的影响很小，且在两种劳动力流动性假设下相近（为0.2个百分点）。但在化石燃料部门，在不流动假设下的影响要大得多，例如煤炭部门的失业率上升13个百分点，这表明忽略劳动力流动摩擦的模型可能大大低估了部门层面的失业效应。将碳税收入通过降低劳动所得税返还，可以减轻甚至逆转对失业的负面影响，而命令控制型政策的效率则较低。

title: Climate Policy, Financial Frictions, and Transition Risk
abstract: We study climate and macroprudential policies in an economy with financial frictions. Using a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model featuring both a pollution market failure and a market failure in the financial sector, we explore transition risk -whether ambitious climate policy can lead to macroeconomic instability. It can, but the risk can be alleviated through macroprudential policies -taxes or subsidies on banks' assets. Then, we explore efficient climate and macroprudential policy in the long run and over business cycles. The presence of financial frictions affects the steady-state value and dynamic properties of the efficient carbon tax. Macroprudential policy alone, without a carbon tax, is not very effective at addressing the pollution externality.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了存在金融摩擦的经济体中的气候政策与宏观审慎政策。我们使用一个同时包含污染市场失灵和金融部门市场失灵的动态随机一般均衡模型，探讨转型风险，即雄心勃勃的气候政策是否会导致宏观经济不稳定。答案是可能的，但这种风险可以通过宏观审慎政策（对银行资产征税或补贴）得到缓解。随后，我们探讨了长期以及经济周期中有效的气候与宏观审慎政策。金融摩擦的存在会影响有效碳税的稳态价值和动态特性。仅有宏观审慎政策而没有碳税，在应对污染外部性方面效果并不显著。

title: Pollution and Labor Market Search Externalities over the Business Cycle
venue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
abstract: We study the relationship between unemployment, environmental policy, and business cycles. We develop a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium real business cycle model that includes both a pollution externality and congestion externalities from labor market search frictions. These frictions generate unemployment on the extensive margin and affect hours worked on the intensive margin. We consider two policies to address the market failures: an emissions tax and a tax or subsidy on job creation. With both policies present, the efficient outcome can be achieved. When one policy is constrained or absent, we solve for the second best. The absence of a vacancy policy to address the congestion externalities substantially affects the value of the emissions tax, both in steady state and over the business cycle.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了失业、环境政策与经济周期之间的关系。我们构建了一个动态随机一般均衡实际经济周期模型，其中既包括污染外部性，也包括劳动力市场搜寻摩擦所带来的拥挤外部性。这些摩擦在广延边际上产生失业，并在集约边际上影响工作时长。我们考虑两种政策来应对这些市场失灵：排放税，以及对职位创造征收的税或提供的补贴。当两种政策同时存在时，可以实现有效率的结果。当其中一种政策受限或缺失时，我们求解次优解。若缺乏应对拥挤外部性的空缺政策，将显著影响排放税在稳态和经济周期中的价值。

title: Research Grants Crowding Out and Crowding In Donations to Higher Education
Business Cycles and Environmental Policy: A Primer
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: We study the relationship between business cycles and the design and effects of environmental policies, particularly those with economy-wide significance like climate policies. First, we provide a brief review of the literature related to this topic, from initial explorations using real business-cycle models to New Keynesian extensions, open-economy variations, and issues of monetary policy and financial regulations. Next, we provide a list of the main findings that emerge from this literature that are potentially most relevant to policy makers, including the impacts of policy on volatility and how to design policy to adjust to cycles. Finally, we propose several important remaining research questions.
abstract_zh: 我们研究经济周期与环境政策的设计及效果之间的关系，尤其是气候政策等具有全经济范围影响的政策。首先，我们简要回顾了该主题的相关文献，内容涵盖从早期运用实际经济周期模型的探索，到新凯恩斯主义的扩展、开放经济的变体，以及货币政策和金融监管问题。接着，我们列出了这一文献中可能与政策制定者最为相关的主要发现，包括政策对波动性的影响，以及如何设计政策以适应周期变化。最后，我们提出了若干重要的待研究问题。

title: Adaptation and the Mortality Effects of Temperature across US Climate Regions
abstract: We estimate how the mortality effects of temperature vary across U.S. climate regions to assess local and national damages from projected climate change. Using 22 years of Medicare data, we find that both cold and hot days increase mortality. How ever, hot days are less deadly in warm places while cold days are less deadly in cool places. Incorporating this heterogeneity into end-of-century climate change assessments reverses the conventional wisdom on climate damage incidence: cold places bear more, not less, of the mortality burden. Allowing places to adapt to their future climate substantially reduces the estimated mortality effects of climate change.
abstract_zh: 我们估计了美国各气候区域内温度对死亡率的影响如何变化，以评估气候变化在地方和全国层面造成的预计损失。利用22年的医疗保险（Medicare）数据，我们发现，寒冷和炎热的日子都会增加死亡率。然而，炎热的日子在温暖地区的致死性较低，而寒冷的日子在凉爽地区的致死性较低。将这种异质性纳入本世纪末的气候变化评估，将颠覆关于气候损害分布的传统认识：寒冷地区承担的死亡负担反而更多，而非更少。允许各地区适应其未来气候，可显著降低所估计的气候变化死亡效应。

title: Efficiency Wages, Unemployment, and Environmental Policy
abstract: We study the incidence of pollution taxes and their impact on unemployment in an analytical general equilibrium efficiency wage model. We find closed-form solutions for the effect of a pollution tax on unemployment, factor prices, and output prices, and we identify and isolate different channels through which these general equilibrium effects arise. An effect arising from the efficiency wage specification depends on the form of the workers' effort function. Numerical simulations further illustrate our results and show that this efficiency wage effect can fully offset the sources-side incidence results found in models that omit it.
abstract_zh: 我们在一个可解析的一般均衡效率工资模型中，研究了污染税的归宿及其对失业的影响。我们求得了污染税对失业、要素价格和产出价格影响的封闭解，并识别和分离出这些一般均衡效应产生的不同渠道。效率工资设定所产生的一种效应取决于工人努力函数的形式。数值模拟进一步说明了我们的结果，并表明，这一效率工资效应可能完全抵消忽略该效应的模型中所发现的供给方归宿效应。

title: Regulating Geoengineering: International Competition and Cooperation
venue: Climate Geoengineering: Science, Law, and Governance

title: Social Science Research to Inform Solar Geoengineering
Bankability and Information in Pollution Policy
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: I assess the role of bankability and information in environmental policy design. I develop a model demonstrating that banking and borrowing can be allowed for a price policy as well as a quantity policy. I compare expected welfare between price and quantity policies, with and without banking, under several different scenarios regarding uncertainty and information. A bankable policy can provide an efficiency improvement by allowing for smoothing of costs, though it is not necessarily more efficient than a policy that does not allow banking. The ranking of prices versus quantities and of bankability versus nonbankability depends on both the slopes of marginal costs and benefits and on the specification of uncertainty and information.
abstract_zh: 我考察了可存储性（bankability）和信息在环境政策设计中的作用。我构建了一个模型，证明无论是价格型政策还是数量型政策，都可以允许存储与借贷。我比较了在不同不确定性和信息情境下，有无存储机制的价格型与数量型政策的期望福利。可存储的政策通过允许成本平滑化，可以带来效率改进，但它不一定比不允许存储的政策更有效。价格型与数量型政策的排序，以及可存储与不可存储的排序，既取决于边际成本和边际收益的斜率，也取决于不确定性和信息的设定。

title: An Analysis of Black Greek-letter Organization Philanthropy
Prospect Theory and Energy Efficiency
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Investments in energy efficiency entail uncertainty, and when faced with uncertainty consumers have been shown to behave according to prospect theory: preferences are reference-dependent and exhibit loss aversion, and probabilities are subjectively weighted. Using data from a choice experiment eliciting prospect theory parameters, I provide evidence that loss-averse people are less likely to invest in energy efficiency. Then, I consider policy design under prospect theory when there are also externalities from energy use.A higher degree of loss aversion implies a higher subsidy to energy efficiency. Numerical simulations suggest that the impact of prospect theory on policy may be substantial.
abstract_zh: 节能投资存在不确定性，而面对不确定性时，消费者的行为已被证明符合前景理论：偏好依赖于参照点并表现出损失厌恶，且概率会被主观加权。利用一项用于估计前景理论参数的选择实验数据，我发现损失厌恶程度更高的人投资节能的可能性更低。随后，我考虑了在存在能源使用外部性的情况下，前景理论影响下的政策设计。损失厌恶程度越高，意味着对节能的补贴应越高。数值模拟表明，前景理论对政策的影响可能相当可观。

title: School Bus Emissions, Academic Performance, and Student Health
abstract: Diesel emissions from school buses expose children to high levels of air pollution; retrofitting bus engines can substantially reduce this exposure. Using variation from 2,656 retrofits across Georgia, we estimate effects of emissions reductions on district-level health and academic achievement. We demonstrate positive effects on respiratory health, measured by a statewide test of aerobic capacity. Placebo tests on body mass index show no impact. We also find that retrofitting districts see significant test score gains in English and smaller gains in math. Results suggest that engine retrofits can have meaningful and cost-effective impacts on health and cognitive functioning.
abstract_zh: 校车排放的柴油废气使儿童暴露于高浓度的空气污染之中，对校车发动机进行改装可以大幅降低这种暴露。利用佐治亚州2,656次改装带来的变异，我们估计了排放减少对学区层面健康和学业成绩的影响。我们证明，这对呼吸系统健康（以全州有氧能力测试衡量）有正面影响。对体重指数的安慰剂检验显示没有影响。我们还发现，进行改装的学区在英语考试成绩上有显著提高，在数学方面的提高较小。结果表明，发动机改装可以对健康和认知功能产生有意义且具有成本效益的影响。

title: The Mortality and Medical Costs of Air Pollution: Evidence from Changes in Wind Direction
abstract: We estimate the causal effects of acute fine particulate matter exposure on mortality, health care use, and medical costs among the US elderly using Medicare data and a novel instrument for air pollution: changes in local wind direction. We develop a new approach that uses machine learning to estimate the life-years lost due to pollution exposure and show that our procedure reduces bias relative to previous methods. Finally, we characterize treatment effect heterogeneity using both life expectancy and generic machine learning inference. Both approaches find that mortality effects are concentrated in about 25 percent of the elderly population.
abstract_zh: 我们利用医疗保险数据以及一个新颖的空气污染工具变量（当地风向变化），估计了急性细颗粒物暴露对美国老年人死亡率、医疗服务使用和医疗费用的因果效应。我们开发了一种新方法，利用机器学习估计污染暴露造成的预期寿命损失，并表明该程序相较于以往方法降低了偏误。最后，我们利用预期寿命和通用机器学习推断，刻画了处理效应的异质性。两种方法均发现，死亡效应集中在约25%的老年人口中。

title: Solar Geoengineering, Uncertainty, and the Price of Carbon
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: We consider the socially optimal use of solar geoengineering to manage climate change. Solar geoengineering can reduce damages from atmospheric greenhouse gas concentrations, potentially more cheaply than reducing emissions. If so, optimal policy includes less abatement than recommended by models that ignore solar geoengineering, and the price of carbon is lower. Solar geoengineering reduces temperature but does not reduce atmospheric or ocean carbon concentrations, and that carbon may cause damages apart from temperature increases. Finally, uncertainty over climate change and solar geoengineering alters the optimal deployment of solar geoengineering. We explore these issues with an analytical model and a numerical simulation. The price of carbon is 30%-45% lower than the price recommended in a model without geoengineering, depending on the parameterizations of geoengineering costs and benefits. Carbon concentrations are higher but temperature is lower when allowing for solar geoengineering. The optimal amount of solar geoengineering is more sensitive to climate uncertainty than is the optimal amount of abatement.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑了如何社会最优地使用太阳地球工程（SGE）来管理气候变化。太阳地球工程可以降低大气温室气体浓度造成的损害，而且可能比减少排放更为便宜。如果确实如此，那么最优政策所包含的减排量将少于忽略太阳地球工程的模型所建议的水平，碳价格也会更低。太阳地球工程降低了气温，但并不降低大气或海洋中的碳浓度，而这些碳本身可能造成温度升高之外的损害。最后，关于气候变化和太阳地球工程的不确定性，会改变太阳地球工程的最优部署。我们借助一个解析模型和一个数值模拟探讨了这些问题。根据太阳地球工程成本和收益设定的不同，碳价格比未考虑太阳地球工程的模型所建议的价格低30%–45%。允许使用太阳地球工程时，碳浓度更高，但气温更低。太阳地球工程的最优规模比减排的最优规模对气候不确定性更为敏感。

title: Time Preferences and Consumer Behavior
Air Pollution and Procyclical Mortality
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Prior research demonstrates that mortality rates increase during economic booms and decrease during economic busts, but little analysis has been conducted investigating the role of environmental risks as potential mechanisms for this relationship. We investigate the contribution of air pollution to the procyclicality of deaths by combining state-level data on overall, cause-specific, and age-specific mortality rates with state-level measures of ambient concentrations of three types of pollutants and the unemployment rate. After controlling for demographic variables and state and year fixed-effects, we find a significant positive correlation between carbon monoxide (CO) concentrations and mortality rates. Controlling for CO, particulate matter (PM10), and ozone (O3) attenuates the relationship between overall mortality and the unemployment rate by 30 percent. The attenuation is particularly large, although imprecisely measured, for fatalities from respiratory diseases and is frequently substantial for age groups unlikely to be involved in the labor market. Our results are consistent with those of other studies in the economics and public health literatures measuring the mortality effects of air pollution.
abstract_zh: 已有研究表明，经济繁荣时期死亡率上升，经济萧条时期死亡率下降，但很少有分析考察环境风险作为这一关系潜在机制的作用。我们将各州总体、分病因和分年龄的死亡率数据，与各州三类污染物的环境浓度测量值及失业率相结合，考察空气污染对死亡率周期性变化的贡献。在控制人口统计变量以及州和年份固定效应后，我们发现一氧化碳（CO）浓度与死亡率之间存在显著的正相关。在控制了CO、可吸入颗粒物（PM10）和臭氧（O3）之后，总体死亡率与失业率之间的关系减弱了30%。对于呼吸系统疾病导致的死亡，这种减弱尤为明显（尽管测量不够精确），而对于不太可能参与劳动力市场的年龄组，这种减弱也较为显著。我们的结果与经济学和公共卫生文献中测量空气污染死亡效应的其他研究结果一致。

title: Climate Engineering Economics
abstract: This article reviews and evaluates the nascent literature on the economics of climate engineering. The literature distinguishes between two broad types of climate engineering: solar radiation management and carbon dioxide removal. We review the science and engineering characteristics of these technologies and analyze the implications of those characteristics for economic policy design. We discuss optimal policy and carbon price, interregional and intergenerational equity issues, strategic interaction in the design of international environmental agreements, and the sources of risk and uncertainty surrounding these technologies. We conclude that climate engineering technologies, similar to mitigation and adaptation, should be a fundamental part of future domestic and global climate policy design. We propose several avenues in need of additional research.
abstract_zh: 本文回顾并评估了关于气候工程经济学的新兴文献。该文献区分了两大类气候工程：太阳辐射管理和二氧化碳移除。我们回顾了这些技术的科学和工程特征，并分析了这些特征对经济政策设计的含义。我们讨论了最优政策与碳价格、区域间和代际公平问题、国际环境协定设计中的战略互动，以及围绕这些技术的风险和不确定性来源。我们的结论是，与减缓和适应一样，气候工程技术应成为未来国内和全球气候政策设计的基本组成部分。我们提出了若干需要进一步研究的方向。

title: Climate Tipping Points and Solar Geoengineering
venue: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
abstract: We study optimal climate policy when climate tipping points and solar geoengineering are present. Solar geoengineering reduces temperatures without reducing greenhouse gas emissions. Climate tipping points are irreversible and uncertain events that cause large damages. We analyze three different rules related to the availability of solar geoengineering: a ban, using solar geoengineering as insurance against the risk of tipping points, or using solar geoengineering only as remediation in the aftermath of a tipping point. We model three distinct types of tipping points: two that alter the climate system and one that yields a direct economic cost. Using an analytic model, we find that an optimal policy, which minimizes expected losses from the tipping point, includes both emissions reductions and solar geoengineering from the onset. Using a numerical simulation model, we quantify optimal policy and various outcomes under the alternative scenarios. The presence of tipping points leads to more mitigation and more solar geoengineering use and lower temperatures.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在存在气候临界点和太阳地球工程的情况下，最优气候政策应如何制定。太阳地球工程可以在不减少温室气体排放的情况下降低气温。气候临界点是不可逆且不确定的事件，会造成巨大损害。我们分析了与太阳地球工程可用性相关的三种不同规则：禁止使用、将太阳地球工程作为应对临界点风险的保险，或仅在临界点发生之后作为补救措施使用。我们对三类不同类型的临界点进行了建模：两类会改变气候系统，一类会产生直接的经济成本。利用解析模型，我们发现，使预期临界点损失最小化的最优政策，从一开始就同时包括减排和太阳地球工程。利用数值模拟模型，我们量化了各替代情景下的最优政策及各种结果。临界点的存在会导致更多的减缓行动、更多的太阳地球工程使用，以及更低的气温。

title: Incidence, Environmental, and Welfare Effects of Distortionary Subsidies
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Government policies that are not intended to address environmental concerns can nonetheless distort prices and affect firms’ emissions. We present an analytical general equilibrium model to study the effect of distortionary subsidies on factor prices, pollution, and welfare. Based on real-world policies, we model an output subsidy, a capital subsidy, relief from environmental regulation, and a minimum level of labor employment that firms must agree to in exchange for the subsidies. Each policy creates both output effects and substitution effects on input prices and emissions. We calibrate the model to the Chinese economy. Variation in production substitution elasticities does not substantially affect input prices, but it does substantially affect emissions. Distortionary subsidies can both raise emissions and decrease output. Therefore, reducing distortionary subsidies can reduce emissions without a trade-off in lost output. Such opportunities arise when the subsidized sector is moderate in size.
abstract_zh: 政府出于非环境目的制定的政策，仍可能扭曲价格并影响企业排放。我们提出一个解析的一般均衡模型，以研究扭曲性补贴对要素价格、污染和福利的影响。基于现实政策，我们模拟了产出补贴、资本补贴、免除环境监管，以及企业为换取补贴而必须同意的最低就业水平等情形。每种政策都会产生对投入价格和排放的产出效应和替代效应。我们以中国经济为校准对象。生产替代弹性的变化不会显著影响要素价格，但会显著影响排放。扭曲性补贴既可能提高排放，也可能降低产出。因此，减少扭曲性补贴可以在不牺牲产出的情况下减少排放。这类机会出现在受补贴部门规模适中的情况下。

title: Consumer Learning and Hybrid Vehicle Adoption
abstract: We study the effect of differences in product quality on new technology diffusion. We propose a model in which heterogeneity in perceived product quality affects consumer adoption. If consumers experientially infer the quality of a technology, an increase in initial exposure to a low-quality product may inhibit subsequent diffusion. Incentives intended to speed up adoption may in fact have the opposite effect, if they propagate low-quality signals. We examine the predictions of the model using sales data for 11 hybrid-vehicle models between 2000 and 2006. Consistent with press reports that the first-generation Insight was perceived to be of lower quality than the first-generation Prius, we find that, conditional on overall hybrid vehicle adoption in the first two years, locations with a relatively high Prius market share experienced faster subsequent adoption than states with a relatively high Insight market share. We estimate the elasticity of new hybrid sales with respect to the Prius penetration rate is 0.30 to 0.55, while the elasticity with respect to the Insight penetration rate is –0.14 to –0.44.
abstract_zh: 我们研究产品质量差异对新技术扩散的影响。我们提出一个模型，其中感知产品质量的异质性会影响消费者的采用行为。如果消费者通过体验来推断技术的质量，那么在最初接触低质量产品的程度增加时，可能会抑制之后的扩散。若激励措施传播了低质量信号，旨在加快采用速度的激励措施实际上可能产生相反的效果。我们利用2000年至2006年间11款混合动力汽车车型的销售数据检验了模型的预测。与媒体报道一致（即第一代Insight被认为质量低于第一代Prius），我们发现，在前两年整体混合动力汽车采用率相同的条件下，Prius市场份额相对较高的地区，其后续采用速度快于Insight市场份额相对较高的州。我们估计，新混合动力汽车销量相对于Prius渗透率的弹性为0.30至0.55，而相对于Insight渗透率的弹性为–0.14至–0.44。

title: Impatience, Incentives, and Obesity
Optimal Policy Instruments for Externality-Producing Durable Goods under Present Bias
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Crowding Out and Crowding In of Private Donations and Government Grants
The Investment Returns of Nonprofit Organizations: Part I, Tales from 990 Forms
The Investment Returns of Nonprofit Organizations: Part II, The Value of Focused Attention
Environmental Macroeconomics: Environmental Policy, Business Cycles, and Directed Technical Change
abstract: Environmental economics has traditionally fallen in the domain of microeconomics, but approaches from macroeconomics have recently been applied to studying environmental policy. We focus on two macroeconomic tools and their application to environmental economics. First, real-business-cycle models can incorporate pollution and pollution policy and can be used to answer several questions. For example, how should environmental policy adjust to business cycles? How do different types of policies fare in a context with business cycles? Second, endogenous technological growth is an important component of environmental policy. Several studies ask how policy can be designed both to tackle emissions directly and to influence the adoption of clean technologies. We focus on these two aspects of environmental macroeconomics but emphasize that there are many other potential applications.
abstract_zh: 环境经济学传统上属于微观经济学领域，但宏观经济学的方法近来也被应用于环境政策研究。我们聚焦于两种宏观经济工具及其在环境经济学中的应用。首先，实际经济周期模型可以纳入污染和污染政策，并可用于回答若干问题。例如，环境政策应如何随经济周期调整？不同类型的政策在经济周期背景下表现如何？其次，内生技术增长是环境政策的重要组成部分。若干研究探讨了如何设计政策，既直接应对排放，又影响清洁技术的采用。我们侧重于环境宏观经济学的这两个方面，但同时强调还有许多其他潜在应用。

title: How Should Environmental Policy Respond to Business Cycles? Optimal Policy under Persistent Productivity Shocks
Plant Vintages, Grandfathering, and Environmental Policy
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Analytical General Equilibrium Effects of Energy Policy on Output and Factor Prices
venue: B.E. Journal of Economic Analysis and Policy
abstract: Using an analytical general equilibrium model, we find solutions for the effect of energy policy on factor prices as well as output prices. We calibrate the model to the U.S. economy, and we consider a tax on carbon dioxide. By looking at expenditure and income patterns across household groups, we quantify the uses-side and sources-side incidence of the tax. When households are categorized either by annual income or by total annual consumption as a proxy for permanent income, the uses-side incidence is regressive. This result is robust to sensitivity analysis over various parameter values. The sources-side incidence can be progressive, U-shaped, or regressive. Results on the sources side are sensitive to parameter values.
abstract_zh: 利用一个解析的一般均衡模型，我们求得了能源政策对要素价格以及产出价格影响的解。我们以美国经济为校准对象，考虑对二氧化碳征税。通过考察不同家庭群体的支出和收入模式，我们量化了该税的使用端归宿和来源端归宿。当家庭按年收入分类，或以总消费（作为永久收入的代理变量）分类时，使用端归宿呈累退性。这一结论对各种参数取值的敏感性分析都是稳健的。来源端归宿可能是累进的、U形的或累退的。来源端的结果对参数取值较为敏感。

title: The General Equilibrium Incidence of Environmental Mandates
abstract: Pollution regulations affect factor demands, relative returns, production, and output prices. In our model, one sector includes pollution as an input that can be a complement or substitute for labor or capital. For each type of mandate, we find conditions where more burden is on labor or on capital. Stricter regulation does not always place less burden on the better substitute for pollution. Also, restrictions on pollution per unit output create an “output-subsidy effect” on factor prices that can reverse the usual output and substitution effects. We find analogous effects for a restriction on pollution per unit capital. (JEL H23, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 污染监管会影响要素需求、相对回报、生产和产出价格。在我们的模型中，有一个部门将污染作为投入，污染可以与劳动或资本互补或替代。对于每种类型的强制性规定，我们找到了负担更多落在劳动或资本上的条件。更严格的监管并不总是将较少的负担置于污染的较好替代品上。此外，对单位产出污染的限制会产生一种“产出补贴效应”，这种效应可能逆转通常的产出效应和替代效应。对单位资本污染的限制也存在类似效应。（JEL H23, Q53, Q58）

title: Testing Implications of a Tournament Model of School District Salary Schedules
The General Equilibrium Incidence of Environmental Taxes
abstract: We study the distributional effects of a pollution tax in general equilibrium, with general forms of substitution where pollution might be a relative complement or substitute for labor or for capital in production. We find closed form solutions for pollution, output prices, and factor prices. Various special cases help clarify the impact of differential factor intensities, substitution effects, and output effects. Intuitively, the pollution tax might place disproportionate burdens on capital if the polluting sector is capital intensive, or if labor is a better substitute for pollution than is capital; however, conditions are found where these intuitive results do not hold. We show exact conditions for the wage to rise relative to the capital return. Plausible values are then assigned to all the parameters, and we find that variations over the possible range of factor intensities have less impact than variations over the possible range of elasticities.
abstract_zh: 我们在一般均衡框架下研究污染税的分配效应，其中允许污染与劳动或资本以一般形式互补或替代。我们得到了污染、产出价格和要素价格的封闭解。若干特例有助于阐明要素密集度差异、替代效应和产出效应的影响。直观上，如果污染部门是资本密集型的，或者劳动是比资本更好的污染替代品，那么污染税可能对资本施加不成比例的负担；然而，我们也找到了一些条件，在这些条件下上述直观结论并不成立。我们给出了工资相对于资本回报上升的确切条件。随后，我们为所有参数赋予合理数值，发现要素密集度在可能范围内的变化，其影响小于弹性在可能范围内的变化所产生的影响。

title: Who Bears the Burden of a Tax on Carbon Emissions in Japan?
